newsitem.title: JAPAN: IBJ links up with Beacon Group of U.S..
newsitem.headline: IBJ links up with Beacon Group of U.S..

text.p: The Industrial Bank of Japan Ltd (IBJ) said on Tuesday it has tied up with the Beacon Group, a U.S. fund management firm that advises on mergers and acquisitions, to strengthen its investment banking business.
IBJ's wholly owned U.S. unit handling mergers and acquisitions, the Bridgeford Group, (NY) Inc, has taken a stake in Beacon, a bank spokesman said without giving details.

IBJ will send staff to join Beacon's management and will exchange information with Beacon on Japanese companies moving into the United States and U.S. companies moving into Japan, he said. Another area of the tie-up includes fund business in which IBJ will invest in funds set up by Beacon, he said.
